name: meaning
description: Language server, formatter, and linter for LaTeX

meaning.formatting.enable.markdownDescription: Enable Meaning as a formatter. When `false`, Meaning contributes no formatting edits (document, range, and on-type formatting), so another formatter can own LaTeX without disabling the extension. The language server keeps running for diagnostics and language features.

meaning.diagnostics.enable.markdownDescription: Show Meaning diagnostics (the linter) in the editor. When `false`, all diagnostics are suppressed, including the syntax/parse errors that a `meaning.toml` `[lint]` selection cannot silence. Formatting and language features are unaffected.

meaning.languageFeatures.enable.markdownDescription: Enable Meaning language features: hover, completion, signature help, go-to-definition, references, document/workspace symbols, rename, code actions, folding, selection ranges, and document links. When `false`, these are suppressed. Formatting and diagnostics are unaffected.

meaning.lineWidth.markdownDescription: Maximum line width before the formatter breaks a line. A fallback only: a discovered `meaning.toml` always wins. Unset by default.

meaning.indentWidth.markdownDescription: Spaces per indent step. A fallback only: a discovered `meaning.toml` wins outright, and absent one your editor's tab size wins. Unset by default.

enabled.description: Whether to scan the TEXMF tree at all.

roots.description: Extra TEXMF root directories to index ahead of the discovered ones.

useKpsewhich.description: Whether to shell out to `kpsewhich` to discover TEXMF roots.

meaning.texmf.markdownDescription: How the language server discovers the installed TeX tree, for document links, package hover, go-to-definition, and installed-set completion. Where TeX is installed is a fact about the machine, not the project, so this lives here rather than in `meaning.toml`. Never affects `meaning format` or `meaning lint`.

meaning.forwardSearch.executable.markdownDescription: PDF viewer launched by the **Meaning: Forward Search** command. A program name, **not a command line** — it is spawned directly, with no shell, so flags must go in `#meaning.forwardSearch.args#`. Unset by default, which disables forward search.

meaning.forwardSearch.args.markdownDescription: Arguments for the viewer. `%f` is the file the cursor is in, `%p` the root document's PDF, `%l` the line number counting from 1, and `%%f` a literal `%f`. Required — forward search stays off until both this and `#meaning.forwardSearch.executable#` are set. For zathura: `["--synctex-forward", "%l:1:%f", "%p"]`.

enumDescriptions: Use the binary bundled inside the extension; fall back to downloading from GitHub if none is bundled or `meaning.version`/`meaning.releaseTag` is set explicitly (default).
Look for `meaning` on the system PATH.
meaning.executableStrategy.markdownDescription: Strategy used to locate the `meaning` executable for the language server.

meaning.executablePath.markdownDescription: Path to the `meaning` executable. Only used when `meaning.executableStrategy` is set to `path`.

meaning.version.description: Meaning version to install (for example: latest or 0.2.0).

meaning.releaseTag.description: Advanced override for exact GitHub release tag (for example: v0.2.0). If explicitly set, this takes precedence over meaning.version.

meaning.githubRepo.description: GitHub repository used for Meaning binary downloads (<owner>/<repo>).

meaning.serverArgs.description: Additional command-line arguments passed after `meaning lsp`.

meaning.serverEnv.description: Environment variables merged into the Meaning language server process.

meaning.extraPath.description: Extra PATH entries prepended for the Meaning language server process.

meaning.logLevel.markdownDescription: Log level for the Meaning language server. Maps to the `RUST_LOG` environment variable. Leave unset to use the server's default. If `meaning.serverEnv.RUST_LOG` is also set, it takes precedence.

meaning.trace.server.description: Trace communication between VS Code and the Meaning language server.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run clean && npm run check-types && npm run bundle:prod
scripts.compile: npm run clean && npm run check-types && npm run bundle
